name: device-added-verified
subject: A device was added to one of your connections

blocks.text: A new device was added to one of your connections. It reads the same mail the connection reads.

facts.label: Reads
facts.value: Sender and date, subject, body text, attachments

blocks.text: You can see what it reads, and revoke it, in Connections at app.permaily.com.
If this wasn't you, sign in at app.permaily.com, revoke it in Connections, sign out the devices you don't know, and write to support@permaily.com.
